summary: KEEP. Acceptance ① (lost receipt never repeats the command): the replay begin converges with already_journaled=true — the caller is told NOT to spawn — and completing again replays the identical delta digest; divergent material under the same operation id is a Conflict; a crash before complete is recovered by QUARANTINE at the next boot (compose runs recovery before any write ingress, fail-closed), never by re-execution. Acceptance ② (lease/quarantine lasts through receipt): the repo-exclusive workspace lock is held from begin (the concurrent second holder refused outright) until complete consumes the guard with the receipt durable; the crash-left operation is quarantined, cannot gain a late receipt, and keeps its tree non-liftable — the P25 terminal-state discipline the envelope rides. Acceptance ③ (CAS rollback preserves later edits): every changed file's after bytes are journaled as refcounted delta-blobs at receipt, and a user's later foreign edit is the observed truth of the next begin's frozen manifest — pinned byte-exact, nothing rolls back.
